newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble demand high, funds sought for taxes, reserves.
newsitem.headline: Rouble demand high, funds sought for taxes, reserves.

text.p: The rouble edged up on Wednesday and dealers said rouble demand was high as banks sought funds to maintain liquidity, pay taxes and meet reserve requirements.
roubles/dollar Jun 11 midday Jun 11 early Jun 10 close
"Budget funds have left commercial banks. The sum demanded was high and it was enough to push today rates lower than the central bank's (bid) rate," Bank Menatep dealer Mikhail Zaretsky said.
He added banks expected rouble supply to grow after the Central Bank sold roubles on Tuesday and Wednesday, but it was buying dollars at low, relatively unattractive rates.
Central Bank First Deputy Chairman Sergei Aleksashenko told Reuters on Wednesday commercial banks were selling dollars to the central bank but not actively.
Another dealer said rouble demand also reflected payments of bank reserve requirements and taxes by Russian companies.
